beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus used a picture His friends would know —

timing.text: Jesus used a picture His friends would know —

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: a vine, and the branches that grow from it.

timing.text: a vine, and the branches that grow from it.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

timing.text: Abide in me, and I in you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Stay in me, he said, and I will stay in you. It has never once done it. All it does is stay attached, and the life of the vine does the rest.

timing.text: Stay in me, he said, and I will stay in you.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: I am the vine, ye are the branches:

timing.text: I am the vine, ye are the branches:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: I am the vine, he said. You are the branches. Not visitors. Not hired hands. Branches — part of the same living thing.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

timing.text: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A branch cut off from the vine doesn't dry up because it's weak. It dries up because it's disconnected.

timing.text: A branch cut off from the vine doesn't dry up because it's weak.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Stay joined to Him, and the life flows. Try to bear fruit on your own, and there's nothing there.

timing.text: Stay joined to Him, and the life flows.

card.text: Stay connected to the Vine. Let His life flow through you.
